evidenceNotes: Official NBEMS FMGE index links October 2026 v2.2 bulletin and the application portal. Exact PDF bytes are retained and hash-bound; replacement requires fresh review.
Bulletin page 2 gives 11 September 2026 17:00 to 25 September 2026 23:55 online application window, in Indian local time. Later edit/document windows do not reopen new applications.

Bulletin page 24 section 4.1 lists Indian citizens and OCI. Page 63 section 8.7 says non-OCI foreign nationals other than Nepalese are ineligible, implying a Nepalese exception. This conflict needs NBEMS or founder clarification; do not mark Nepalese as automatically eligible.

Bulletin page 33 section 5.1 says MCQ response options are in English only. It does not set a CEFR or other general language proficiency level. Prior MBBS admission criteria include English marks, a different requirement.

Bulletin page 17 section 2.17 and pages 91-92 section 10.11 say appearing in FMGE or obtaining a pass certificate does not automatically grant NMC/State Medical Council registration. Council verification is separate.
Bulletin pages 53 onward list tentative test cities; individual centre allotment is later. No city-centre pin is used as an actual exam venue.
